description: Source code for the LabelController class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing labels and their associations with emails in a user system, including CRUD operations, assignment, unassignment, and retrieval of labeled emails.

classes.name: LabelController
classes.description: REST controller for label CRUD and assignment operations.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on the provided authentication object.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns paginated list of labels for the current user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new label for the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates name and/or color of a specified label owned by the user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a label and removes it from all emails.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns given labels to a specified email belonging to the user.

methods.name: unassign
methods.description: Removes given labels from a specified email owned by the user.

methods.name: emailsByLabel
methods.description: Retrieves paginated emails associated with a specified label for the current user.
